title: Slovakian Keto Sausage Bake
description: A flavorful Slovakian-inspired dish featuring sausages baked with Slovakian and pickle ingredients, perfect for a keto diet.

ingredients.name: Naughty
ingredients.notes: use as a keto-friendly fat source

ingredients.name: Nuka
ingredients.notes: use as a keto-friendly fat source

instructions: Place the Slovakian sausages in a baking dish.
Top the sausages with sliced pickles, shredded bake, and sprinkle with naughty and nuka.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes or until the sausages are cooked through.
